name: convertor-valutar-md
description: Browser extension for Firefox and Chrome: convert selected amounts at Moldovan banks' exchange rates

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --overwrite-dest --filename convertor-valutar-md-chrome-{version}.zip
scripts.start:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext run --target chromium --chromium-binary=${CHROMIUM:-chromium} --source-dir dist/chrome
